text:
marco (prod-designer): Quick design catch from usability testing: people assume the stacked weight bars are historical metrics, not simulated distribution. We should make the legend and label affordance clearer.
tiya (frontend): Yep saw that too. Idea: add a small header row above the preview that says 'Preview (simulated distribution)' and change the legend label from 'Weight' to 'Relative weight (%)'.
jon (pm): Also heard confusion on the tiny toggle that switches to "absolute samples". Users miss it. Can we make it a pill with text 'View: % | samples'?
elena (engineer): Implementation constraints: the samples view requires requesting average throughput from the backend (est.req/min). That's an extra call; we should cache it per-policy and debounce while editing.
marco (prod-designer): UX: show small skeleton counts while fetching so the row doesn't jump. And if backend call fails, show '—' with tooltip 'Unavailable for unsaved configs'.
tiya (frontend): For keyboard users, the percent toggle isn't tabbable right now because it's nested in the canvas. I'll lift it outside and ensure it has aria-pressed states.
contrast-bot: :warning: Color contrast alert: cyan-500 used for small labels is 3.2:1 on white. Fails AA for small text. Recommend neutral-900 or cyan-700.
jon (pm): Microcopy suggestion for the toggles: 'Percent (relative) vs Samples (est. req/min)'. Keep tooltip copy short.
elena (engineer): Also note drag reorder focus gets lost when show-samples triggers a reflow. We'll need to preserve focus by storing focused rule id and restoring post-render.
marco (prod-designer): Good point. Add aria-live="polite" for the preview summary so screen readers get update context, but not for errors.
tiya (frontend): CSS tokens I'll try: `--preview-legend-font-size: 12px; --preview-bar-height: 7px; --preview-handle-hit: 44px;` Also will ensure the legend uses a heavier neutral token for small text.
jon (pm): Can we reword the overlap validation to be more actionable? Current: 'Overlap detected.' Propose: 'Overlap: "Blue-Green" overlaps "Default". Make targets mutually exclusive or lower priority.'
elena (engineer): I'll implement the focus restoration and memoize sample rates with a ttl of 60s. Need stable rule ids across edits.
marco (prod-designer): One more UX note: add a color-blind friendly palette option in the preview settings. Many testers asked for it. Could be a prefs toggle.
contrast-bot: :white_check_mark: Suggestion approved: use token neutral-900 for text <14px and provide alt palette swatches that pass 4.5:1.
tiya (frontend): I'll sketch the pill toggle + legend relocation and include keyboard states. Expect a PR with screenshots tomorrow.
jon (pm): Thanks all. Elena and Tiya, can you pair on focus preservation and aria attributes after standup? I'll own copy updates.
elena (engineer): Yep, 20m after standup works.
marco (prod-designer): I'll update Figma with the new header, pill toggle, and color-blind option and drop the link here when ready. :sparkles:
